instruction: Chrome auto-opens funbrain.com at startup. Fix that, and also increase the default font size to Large in Chrome's appearance settings.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y
cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"session":{"restore_on_startup":4, "startup_urls":["http://funbrain.com/"]}}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated Chrome Settings to fix the startup page. This variation adds a second objective: changing font size to Large (20) in Chrome's Appearance settings.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Chrome Settings sections including On startup and Appearance, modify startup pages and font size settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads Chrome Preferences file (session.restore_on_startup, session.startup_urls, webkit.webprefs.default_font_size) - no UI dependency, always accessible on disk.

Metric sub-goal 1 (startup fix): condition 'not has_funbrain or restore != 4' correctly fails the initial state (restore=4, has_funbrain=True) and passes after valid fixes (remove funbrain URL or change restore mode). Semantically sound.

Metric sub-goal 2 (font size): expected parameter handling is correct - since expected.type='rule', framework passes rules dict directly as expected; metric uses expected.get('default_font_size', 20) which correctly accesses {'default_font_size': 20}.
Expected value 20 correctly corresponds to Chrome's 'Large' font size setting in webkit.webprefs.default_font_size.
Both instruction requirements (startup fix + Large font) are covered with appropriate 0.5/0.5 partial credit scoring.
No postconfig needed since Chrome Preferences file is always accessible on disk regardless of UI state.
